sloka: लता शतैर् अवतताः सन्तानक समावृताः ।नाना गुल्म आवृत वनाः कर वीर कृत अन्तराः ॥५-१४-२६॥
transliteration: latā śatair avatatāḥ santānaka samāvṛtāḥ ।nānā gulma āvṛta vanāḥ kara vīra kṛta antarāḥ ॥5-14-26॥

translations.english: He observed ponds of different shapes filled with clear water with steps paved with rich gems, with sands of pearls and corals and bottoms of crystal, which contained beds of lotuses in bloom, adorned with chakravaka birds and resonant with cacklings of swans and sarasas and vatyuhas rubbing their beaks. There were golden platforms built on banks and platforms built of crystals. There were trees on the bank of streams, and nectarlike sacred waters flowing in them surrounded by hundreds of creepers, and Ashoka blossoms scattered everywhere, with thickly grown bushes of different kinds, with lilies in bloom in tanks.
translations.hindi: सुख भोगने योग्य प्रौर कभी दुःख न भोगे हुए, किन्तु श्रव दुःखसन्तप्ता, मलिन वेश बनाए ग्रौर दुबली-पतली उस विशाल नयनी को देख, हनुमानजी ने तके-वितक द्वारा ग्रनेक कारणों से श्रपने मन में निश्चय किया कि, यही सीता हैं । वह मन ही मन 'कहने लगे कि, कामरूपी रावण जब इनको हर कर लिये भ्राता था
